Same-day appointments available

Unexpected dental problems can disrupt your day and your peace of mind. At My Dear Dentist, you don’t have to face that stress alone. We prioritize urgent visits so you can get fast relief from pain and compassionate support from a team that treats you like family.

Whether you’re dealing with a sudden toothache, cracked tooth, lost filling, or another urgent concern, our Montrose emergency dentists offer same-day care, honest guidance, and comfort-first treatment rooted in whole-body wellness.

Get fast, compassionate care today to protect your smile and health.
The care you need, from the dentists you trust

Experience you can count on

With more than 20 years of combined experience, Dr. Nour Amin and Dr. Mustafa Shinta, your Montrose emergency dentists, deliver thoughtful, precise care, even in stressful moments.

FAQs

items.title: What is the most common dental emergency?
items.html: The most common concerns patients see us for are toothaches — that’s because pain is your body’s way of signaling something isn’t right! Under the surface, you may be dealing with decay, gum disease, cracked or worn teeth, or an abscess. Our Montrose emergency dentists can help you if you have lost or broken a tooth.

items.title: What are the signs of an infected tooth?
items.html:
A few common symptoms of a tooth infection include:
  • Throbbing toothache
  • Lingering tooth sensitivity
  • Sore and sensitive jawbone
  • Sensitivity to hot and cold
  • Pain or tingling when biting

items.title: Will my tooth need to be pulled?
items.html: Not necessarily. Our Montrose emergency dentist will conduct a thorough examination and diagnosis to evaluate the best course of action, whether that’s a filling, crown, root canal, gum disease treatment, or something else!

items.title: Will a toothache go away on its own?
items.html: If you’re feeling uncomfortable, you should always visit a professional…even if the pain goes away after a few days, there’s likely an issue hidden under the surface, and the pain will return even worse than before.
